_readme: Hand-edited inputs for scripts/build_data.py: content that is a judgment or a game rule, not data read from the .md files.
Values here are merged into KS_DATA as-is. A key that the .md parser also produces is an error (the build fails).
Field meanings: docs/SCHEMA.md. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.

rules.drillCamp: Slotted heroes auto-level to the lowest of the 5 instructors' levels (in-game text, 22 and 25 Oct) and use no XP. Level Resets set a hero to Lv 1 and refund all their Hero XP (in-game text, 22 and 25 Oct). A hero removed from Drill Camp returns to its own level (community sources).
rules.oneMarchPerHero: A hero can be in only one march at a time.

skillBooks.text: Skill book counts (a/b on a skill's Upgrade button) are your shared stock of that book type, not progress saved on that skill. Each rarity has its own books: Epic heroes share Epic books, Mythic heroes share Mythic books, so books spent on one Epic hero are gone for every other Epic hero. Book type names are read from the icons.

recommendations.what: Test a combat hero instead of Forrest in the Be (beast) march
recommendations.why: Forrest's two expedition skills only help wood (Woodland Inheritor: sawmill output; Master Woodcutter: wood gathering), so they do nothing in a beast fight. Diana (lead: -18% stamina, +60% hunting march speed) and Gordon (+15% squad Attack and Health) stay. Helga is the closest swap: she is also infantry, so the troop mix stays the same, and she adds Echoes of Valhalla (+10% squad Attack) and Oath of Guardian (16% chance to halve damage taken). Her hero power is lower (259,615 vs Forrest's 371,073), so test it before keeping it.

changes.note: Same classes (Archer, Cavalry, Infantry) and the same troop split

steps: Deploy → Be → remove Forrest → add Helga → Save.
Hit the same beast level you use now and compare troop losses with an earlier hunt.

Other options if Helga does worse: Fahd (-12% enemy damage dealt; Cavalry like Gordon) or Saul (+6% DEF, +9% HP, +5% Lethality; Archer like Diana); whether two heroes of the same class can share a march is not recorded. If Helga replaces him, Forrest would use them only for gathering; Helga already wears Epic gear (Helm +10, Gloves +0, Shroud +3 on 22 Oct), so which of the two should get the Rare pieces is not worked out yet.

recommendations.what: Skill books: next 50 Epic Conquest Books to Howard's Defenders' Edge, next 50 Epic Expedition Manuals to Howard's Joint Defense
recommendations.why: Skill books are a shared stock per type, so each 50 books buys one Lv. 3 → 4 upgrade for one hero. The ranking puts first the skills that help every troop or hero (not just the hero himself) on heroes used in the most line-ups. Conquest Books upgrade march (expedition) skills: Howard leads Att and is in Barricade 1, and Defenders' Edge cuts damage taken by all troops from 12% to 16%, which lowers losses whether you attack or are attacked. Expedition Manuals upgrade Arena (exploration) skills: Howard is in the front of both Arena squads, and Joint Defense raises Defense for all heroes from 10% to 12.5%. The cheaper Lv. 2 → 3 upgrades (30 books) on Fahd, Amane and Saul are not ranked first because none of them is in a march or Arena squad.
steps: Epic Conquest Books (28 in stock on 25 Oct; 50 needed): 1. Howard · Defenders' Edge (all troops take 12% → 16% less damage; Att lead, Barricade 1). 2. Gordon · Trash Talk (all squads +15% → +20% Attack; Be march, Barricade 2). 3. Quinn · Precision Shot (50% chance of +30% → +40% damage; Att, Barricade 1).

Epic Expedition Manuals (26 in stock on 25 Oct; 50 needed): 1. Howard · Joint Defense (all heroes +10% → +12.5% Defense; front of both Arena squads). 2. Quinn · Headshot (Attack × 480% → 520%; back of both Arena squads). 3. Diana · Incendiary Arrows (250% → 270%, AoE 84% → 91%; back of both Arena squads).

Mythic Conquest Books (17 in stock on 25 Oct; 50 needed): Jabel · Youthful Rage (all squads +15% → +20% Lethality; Att, Barricade 1). Saul's Positional Battler needs only 30 for the same +5%, but Saul is in no march.

Mythic Expedition Manuals (22 in stock on 25 Oct; 50 needed): Jabel · Persistence (+40% → +50% Attack Speed below 50% Health; both Arena squads). Saul's Lv. 2 skills need 30 each, but Saul is in no Arena squad.
